title: Exact boundary vocabulary in generated validation receipts
failure_signature: A generated receipt expressed authoritative ownership but omitted the exact canonical-role term required by the frozen validation rule, causing one of 56 scoped tests to fail.
trigger_preconditions: user boundary uses a term of art
validator asserts the explicit frozen role
candidate_workaround: Carry exact boundary vocabulary into generated receipts and tests for canonical role, named lane, same-owner replay, and independent-reproduction limits.
recurrence_guard: Treat frozen role labels as schema values rather than prose synonyms and mutation-test their presence.
rollback: Restore the prior receipt only if the exact term misstates evidence; otherwise retain the failed test and regenerate the bounded receipt.
scope_boundary: Receipt vocabulary and validator alignment only; exact words do not manufacture missing evidence or authority.
